'''Trerein "Tre" E. Roberson''' (born October 22, 1992) is an American professional [[gridiron football|football]] [[defensive back]]. He was signed by the [[Minnesota Vikings]] as an undrafted free agent following the [[2016 NFL draft]]. He then played for the [[Calgary Stampeders]] of the [[Canadian Football League]] (CFL) until he signed with the [[Chicago Bears]] in 2020. Prior to entering the NFL, Roberson played [[college football]] as a [[quarterback]] for the [[Indiana Hoosiers football|Indiana Hoosiers]] and the [[Illinois State Redbirds football|Illinois State Redbirds]]. Roberson had a 3–4 record for his career as the starting quarterback at Indiana and a 23–5 record for Illinois State.

Roberson played [[high school football]] at [[Lawrence Central High School]], where he was a two-sport athlete, and won the 2010 [[Mr. Football Award (Indiana)|Indiana Mr. Football]]. He committed to [[Indiana University]] on April 10, 2010, and became the first ever [[true freshman]] to start at quarterback for the Hoosiers. In June 2014, Roberson announced his intentions to leave [[Indiana Hoosiers football|Indiana]] and transfer to [[Illinois State Redbirds football|Illinois State University]] of the [[Football Championship Subdivision|FCS]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Tre Roberson announces transfer to Illinois State |author=Sean Merriman |url=http://btn.com/2014/06/13/former-iu-qb-tre-roberson-announces-transfer-to-illinois-state/ |date=June 13, 2014 |access-date=June 15, 2014}}</ref>
